notes: Rules of the market where the promotion is received apply; issuer home-state rules also apply.

The EU rulebook covers fund marketing (UCITS/AIFs) under Regulation (EU) 2019/1156 and ESMA34-45-1272; it does not cover MiFID II investment-firm communications, PRIIPs or national rules such as German WpHG or BaFin circulars.
ESMA guidelines are comply-or-explain for national regulators; check the ESMA compliance table for a given country's status.

The US rulebook covers SEC-registered investment advisers (Marketing Rule) and FINRA member broker-dealers (Rule 2210); which one applies depends on who issues the communication. State rules and FINRA filing requirements are not covered.
Each rulebook is a selection of key rules, not the full regime. Output is a first-pass review to support, not replace, a qualified compliance officer.
Rule texts are quoted from official sources (FCA Handbook, EUR-Lex, ESMA, eCFR, FINRA) as retrieved in October 2026; rules change, so re-check before relying on them.
